data.narrative:
Olympian Motors is a Seed-stage transportation company founded by Eren Canarslan and Jasmine Sungu that has raised $9.6M to date. The broader transportation sector comp universe consists of six private peers including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Navier, and EarthGrid, with no public comparables identified.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach here. Using the $9.6M total raised as a proxy for enterprise value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $24M. Peer-median triangulation is not feasible; while three same-sector peers exist in transportation, none satisfy the narrow filtering criteria of matching stage, adjacent stage, or comparable valuation tier required for reliable benchmarking. Falling back to all-sector median would introduce excessive noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $20M to $28M, centered on $24M. This range reflects standard early-stage advancement assumptions but remains subject to material uncertainty around (1) the absence of proximate peer valuation data in transportation, limiting validation of the stage-progression multiple, and (2) the nascent and heterogeneous nature of the sector, which may not follow conventional venture step-up patterns. Management should validate this range against any recent seed-to-Series A financing activity in frontier transportation.
